prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1468; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported at the intersection in Baytown. Can you confirm that you were the driver of your vehicle at the time?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car.

Q: Please describe how the collision happened, in your own words.

A: I was going through the intersection on a green light. The other vehicle came in from the side street and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming until it was almost on me.

Q: Did you have any chance to brake or swerve before impact?

A: I hit the brakes, but there wasn't enough time to avoid it.

Q: Was anyone else in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Did you call the police or get a report made at the scene?

A: Yes, an officer came out and took information from both drivers. I think he wrote up a report.

Q: Where did you first feel injured?

A: My neck. It snapped to the side when we were hit, and I felt a stiff, sore feeling right away.

Q: Have you seen a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same day. They diagnosed a neck strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatories.

Q: Are you currently having any other symptoms, such as headaches or pain in your shoulders or back?

A: A little tightness in the upper shoulders, and I get some headaches toward the end of the day. The neck is still the worst part.

Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?

A: I've been out a few days and I'm working lighter duties now.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Just that I was careful and followed the signals. I want the repairs and my treatment covered.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
